name: Löwenzahn 4: Geschichten aus Natur, Umwelt und Technik
summary: Fourth installment of the German educational game series "Löwenzahn". The themes of this game include Stone Age, evolution, sewer, bridges, digestion, the skeleton, space travel and cosmos.
